quoting_convention: The PDF text file is a column-wise extraction: every table cell and every soft-wrapped prose line sits on its own line separated by blank lines. For readability, prose quotes below are whitespace-normalised (soft line-wraps collapsed to a single space) and table-row quotes are reconstructed by joining the consecutive extracted cells with ' | ' in the order they appear in the file. No words have been added, removed or reordered. The pdf_line_hint field gives the exact line range in atha_pdf_text.txt so any quote can be re-verified against the raw extraction. Master-prompt quotes are literal, including leading markdown list markers and backticks.
